g.text: Longer budgets improve every complete matched configuration

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4f6170

g.text: 71 exact configuration matches | Primary endpoint: last regular validation | Lower PPL is better
Each point is one exact fixed-configuration match; means are not pooled across configurations.
Error bars show ±1 sample SD across the three original seeds (some are smaller than the marker). Both axes are logarithmic.
71 of 88 new configurations are included. Sixteen lack exact 100M controls; one additional matched configuration is incomplete.
ALiBi availability is limited by original OOM cells; unavailable results are not imputed.
Separate exploratory comparison: larger token budgets change optimizer steps and data exposure versus the 100M controls.
These observations describe budget effects; they do not establish statistical significance.
